'''Note:''' This hub is the '''Virtual Legacy''' (2009&ndash;2014 Block packaging) entry for Defensive Shields. For the Original-era printable slips see [[Defensive Shields]] (alias redirect: [[Virtual Shields (Original)]]). Alias: [[Virtual Shields (Legacy)]].

'''Virtual Shields''' (Legacy Defensive Shields) is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The hub Date keeps the '''earlier''' first-appearance window '''~2006-07''' (Defensive Shields / Virtual Shields packaging placed between Virtual Sets 11 and 12 on contemporaneous secondary lists; Original-era printable slips are documented on [[Defensive Shields]] (Resources DefensiveShields.pdf, Dec 2006)).<ref name="premiumshields">https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html</ref> Primary PDF brackets: after VS11 official text '''4 December 2006''' and before VS12 official text '''9 January 2007''' (exact Original shields PDF / news day still unknown; Alpha1 '''NOT FOUND'''). The shields were later grouped/labeled as Virtual Block Defensive Shields in the September/October 2009 Block packaging era (cardlist snapshot 2 October 2009).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.
